careers.name: AI and machine learning engineer
careers.about: Builds models that read text, images and data. Nepal has a few product and outsourcing teams hiring; most pay and growth come from remote and overseas work.

careers.name: Forest officer and conservationist
careers.about: Manages community forests, national parks and carbon projects. Work is mostly with the government, INGOs and research groups.

careers.name: Commercial pilot
careers.about: Flies passenger and cargo aircraft. Training is costly and needs a licence from the aviation authority, but airlines at home and abroad pay well.

careers.name: Food technologist
careers.about: Tests, preserves and develops food and drink products. Dairy, beverage, noodle and packaged food plants hire in every province.

careers.name: Environment and climate officer
careers.about: Writes impact assessments, tracks emissions and runs climate projects for the government, hydropower firms and development agencies.

routes.name: BIT (Bachelor in Information Technology)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream with Maths in many colleges
routes.about: A software focused degree with projects in web, mobile and databases. It sits next to BCA and BSc CSIT, so compare the syllabus and the college's project record before you choose.

routes.name: BSc Forestry
routes.about: Covers forests, soil, wildlife and community resource management. Graduates work in the forest service, national parks, conservation groups and climate projects.

routes.name: BTech Food Technology
routes.about: Food processing, safety and quality control. A small field with steady hiring from dairy, beverage and packaged food plants and from government quality labs.

routes.name: BSc Environmental Science
routes.about: Air, water, waste and climate through lab and field work. Fits impact assessment, climate projects, municipalities and NGOs.

routes.name: Commercial pilot training
routes.entry: +2 Science with Physics and Maths, medical fitness
routes.about: Flight school, ground exams and flying hours leading to a commercial licence from the aviation authority. Costs are high and jobs are limited, so check the school's approval and placement before paying.
routes.exam: Aviation authority exams and a medical

providers.name: Central Campus of Technology, Hattisar
providers.note: Tribhuvan University campus known for food technology and science programmes in eastern Nepal. Confirm the current intake and fee on its notice page.

providers.name: Institute of Forestry, Pokhara Campus
providers.note: Tribhuvan University institute for forestry degrees, with a second campus at Hetauda. Check the campus site for seats and the entrance date.

scholarships.name: Taiwan Scholarship (MOFA and MOE)
scholarships.covers: Tuition support and a monthly stipend, with some Chinese language support
scholarships.who: Students from partner countries with good grades and the language score the university asks for
scholarships.how: Apply through the Taiwan representative office and the university portal; dates change every year

scholarships.name: Italian Government Scholarships (Study in Italy)
scholarships.covers: Monthly allowance, with fee waivers at many universities
scholarships.who: Graduates with a strong record and the language score of the chosen course
scholarships.how: Apply on the official Study in Italy portal and a university portal; check the yearly call

scholarships.name: Rhodes Scholarship (South Asia)
scholarships.covers: Full fees, a living stipend and travel for postgraduate study at Oxford
scholarships.who: Graduates with an outstanding record, leadership and service
scholarships.how: Apply to the South Asia selection each year; read the current country list on the Rhodes site

scholarships.name: Singapore SINGA (A*STAR) PhD Award
scholarships.covers: Monthly stipend, fees and a research allowance
scholarships.who: Research minded graduates applying for a science or engineering PhD
scholarships.how: Apply online in the yearly intake

abroad.work: Part-time work allowed in term and full-time in holidays on most student permits
abroad.note: Check the immigration site for current funds and work rules; do not pay an agent for visa guarantees.

abroad.work: Limited part-time work for degree students at approved universities
abroad.note: Entry to public universities is very competitive; private institutes vary a lot, so check approval before paying.

abroad.work: Part-time work allowed up to a weekly limit on a student permit
abroad.note: Public universities charge low fees by family income and the regional scholarship covers many students. Apply early for the pre-enrolment step.

abroad.work: Part-time work allowed after the first term with a permit
abroad.note: Many universities offer English taught programmes and their own scholarships; read the university page first.
